## Handoff evidence

**Qualification binding verified.** Every member digest in the cohort manifest matches the local candidate bytes: all nine representation members and all seven Axiom members, including the joiner executable, the program and the map. The store manifest digest matches the value in native-context, the task definition and the qualification basis. Skill symlink targets match. The child rc.6 tags are null in the cohort's expected remote, so this is the commit-B construction candidate used under its construction grant, not released-use qualification.

**Frame selection from the map.** Selected from top-level frame_refs: the derived Executive frame (my role) and the derived Worker frame (handoff target). Not selected: the derived Reviewer frame and the generic reference-frame laws. Selected frame index: executive-steel-thread-delivery. Inspected and not selected: both t009 complete-update indexes, because their scope is a complete consumer update, not this subject.

**Source re-entry performed** through the map's source routes into the installed rc.6 standards: baseline sections on status and authority boundary, engagement applicability, Executive, Executive attention and action, Worker, work result, derived Executive frame, steel-thread delivery, derived Worker frame, the full Product testing frame set, complete engagement transition and handoff projection; reference-frame method sections on applicability, closed results and conjunction; ticket-method sections on judgment continuity and condition-based closure; spec-method sections on classification and treatment and on construction and delegation.

**Tool observations.**
- The projection of the Executive index ran in reference-only and materialized modes to stdout, both exit 0, reporting the same program and map identities as the map file.
- The join ran as `ac.py join --input /dev/stdin` with no output flag, exit 0. Stdin was 11244 bytes. The returned request is 11047 bytes, sha256 e8178ff92008d2ad9036a25a9dd3ad056b18ac7be5182a37347d3bd3ae1d6dc4, with no trailing newline. The joined_request field above is that output verbatim.
- No worksite file was created or modified: the newest modification time is the fixture setup at 00:00:39, and no cache or stray output exists.

**Not done, by design.** No Worker was activated, no user was contacted, no file or Git state changed, and the Duty Roster work itself has not been executed. The join records the request bytes only.
